claim_boundary: Learning-only calculator and Workflow evidence; not nickel scientific validation, numerical convergence, production suitability, or project material-scope expansion.
diagnostic_interpretation: Every stderr stream contains the same QE floating-point exception flags. They are retained and are not classified as harmless or fatal.
limitations: The tutorial settings were executed once and were not tested for cutoff, k-point, smearing, magnetic-state, lattice, or band-count convergence.
The starting magnetization is an input seed, while the reported total and absolute magnetizations are calculated outputs; neither is a validated nickel reference value.
Spin-component labels follow QE's collinear convention and the tutorial source; no independent physical spin-axis convention was supplied.
Sampled resident-memory observations may underestimate instantaneous maxima.
The recurring floating-point exception flags remain uncharacterized.

spin_resolved_bands.spin_component_convention: QE collinear spin_component=1 and 2; source-labeled up and down, without an independently specified rotated physical spin axis.
